disposition_reason: Nine branded ready-to-eat products (three noodles, two pasta, two oats, two soups) were analysed for Zn, Cd, Pb and Cu by voltammetry after two preparations; Tables 3-4 print one value per product.

study.design: small retail screening of ready-to-eat noodles, pasta, oats and soups
study.market: mega market stores (Mumbai, India, per affiliation)
study.method: sample DC voltammetry, static mercury drop electrode, standard addition; two preparations: 0.1 N HCl digestive extraction and dry ashing
study.qa: no CRM or recovery; agreement between two preparations used as validation

unresolved: Detection limits, sample collection dates, city and product types (e.g. soup flavor) are not stated; Mumbai inferred from author affiliation.

Brand codes A-C kept as retail brand labels.
Limits cited are Google search URLs.
